command: loginctl show-session c3 -p Name -p User -p State -p Type -p Class -p Display -p Remote -p Service -p Leader 2>/dev/null || true; LEADER=$(loginctl show-session c3 -p Leader --value 2>/dev/null || true); if [ -n "$LEADER" ] && [ -r "/proc/$LEADER/environ" ]; then printf '%s\n' '--- selected session env ---'; tr '\0' '\n' < "/proc/$LEADER/environ" | grep -E '^(DISPLAY|WAYLAND_DISPLAY|XDG_SESSION_TYPE|XDG_RUNTIME_DIR|DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS)=' || true; fi
